{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_refp_director_policy", "thread_id": "th_refp_director", "from_": "referral-director@company.example.com", "to": ["me"], "subject": "Referral Program Policy Update - January 2026", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": false, "date": "2026-01-27T09:00:00Z"}
消息 ID：msg_refp_director_policy
来源：referral-director@company.example.com
收件人：me
日期：2026-01-27T09:00:00Z
主题：Referral Program Policy Update - January 2026
Hi team,

Updated referral processing policy for Q1 2026:

Section 1: Standard referrals
Process referrals where the referee is not already an active customer.

Section 2: Existing customers
Skip if referee is already an active customer in HubSpot (no re-engage flag).

Section 3: Fraud and blocks
Skip if HubSpot shows referral_override=block or fraud_flag=true.

Section 4: Standard tracking code
Use tracking code REFP-661-Q1 in all standard new-customer thank-you emails.

Section 5: Re-engage overrides
If HubSpot shows referral_override=re-engage, the referee is a former customer to win back -- process these and use tracking code REFP-RENG-2026 in the thank-you email instead of REFP-661-Q1.

Section 6: Mark processed
Update the sheet to processed=Yes for each completed referral.

Thanks,
Referral Program Director"}
